title: Side By Side | Perfect for Large Celebrations
description:
Welcome to Sky Lounge by Stay Minty 🌟

2 side-by-side HOMES with a DOUBLE Rooftop TERRACE  - Stunning Views of Downtown Nashville  - up to 24 guests

The space
👋 HEY FRIEND! Welcome to Sky Lounge at City Heights 1 & 2 by STAY MINTY!

🔥IMPRESSIVE FEATURES
• Rooftop Balcony – Perfect for a get-together
• Panoramic Views
• Grill
• Chef’s Kitchen
• Fun Decorations
• Luxurious Bedding

🧘 Total RELAXATION
•  Over 3,900 sq. ft.
•  8 Bedrooms • 20 Beds • Sleeps 24
• Memory-Foam Mattresses
• Stream movies
• Designer Finishes

🎉 CELEBRATE with Stay Minty - an Industry Leading, Design-Forward, Hospitality Brand Helping Groups CELEBRATE Together

🌟 Entertainer's Dream 🌟
▸ Fresh interiors and thoughtfully designed, this home's large open floor plan and spacious interiors make it perfect for groups traveling together.
▸ There's plenty of seating and bedding for everyone without feeling cramped.

🌃 Rooftop Terrace 🌃
● The showstopper here is the huge rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the downtown Nashville.
● You'll also love the gas chef's grill ready for your famous barbecue ribs!
● The perfect place for everyone to gather for drinks, food and fun!!

💎 High-End Décor 💎
● Spread out in style with over 3,900 square feet of interior space complete with designer finishes, gorgeous hardwood floors, high-end furnishings and beautiful artwork throughout.
● Stay Minty rounded up the highest quality, most luxurious beds, bedding and linen in the south! You'll sleep like a dream - refreshed each morning ready to explore.
● There are three end-suite bathrooms, and a half hallway bathroom
● The master shower is a fan favorite and includes multiple fixtures with ceiling mounted rain experience and chroma-therapy.
● The kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, gas stove and ample counter space.
● Spa Bathrooms

🧼 EVERY HOME EVERY TIME
In a Stay Minty home, you’ll always find our bathrooms stocked with everything you need to get squeaky clean including shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. Our kitchens have all the essentials needed to prepare your favorite meal. Get your caffeine fix each morning with Keurig coffee pods included with every stay. We’ve even got your TV entertainment covered with hundreds of streaming options to choose from.

📦 SUPPLY STARTER KIT
No one wants to have to worry about getting to the store after traveling all day! That’s why we provide a supply starter kit – to get you through the first day or two of your stay. The kit includes a roll of paper towels, dish sponge, two dishwasher pods, five trash bags, dishwashing liquid, all-purpose cleaner, a small selection of coffee pods, hand soap, shampoo, conditioner, body wash and two rolls of toilet paper in each bathroom.

✨ Stay Minty homes are immaculate and well maintained by professionals who clean between every guest using the highest standards in the industry.

💚 OUR PROMISE
At Stay Minty, we’re a dedicated and small (yet mighty) team on a mission to bring more passion and joy into the world through shared experiences. And great news for you, we both have the same goal: for your stay to be nothing short of perfect. With that said, sometimes the unexpected happens. Our homes are houses, no different than yours. Maybe ours are a little cooler, but that’s why you’re here. If anything comes up, we promise to spring into action faster than Taylor Swift after a break-up and do everything we can to resolve it… and then maybe write a hit album about it. I mean, we are from “Music City, USA”.

📲 If you have any issues or are unhappy with your stay, be sure to call, text, or email us like a good friend so we can get your stay back to minty fresh.

We look forward to you booking our home and hosting your stay!!

xoxo,
Stay Minty!

Note: For safety and security, our property is equipped with exterior-only cameras located at the front entrance and driveway. These devices monitor the property perimeter and do not record any interior areas. There are no cameras inside the home.

Other things to note
MINIMUM AGE REQUIREMENTS:
The primary renter must be at least 25 years old. Exceptions are made on a case-by-case basis. Contact us for details prior to booking.

**Guests aged 21 - 24 are eligible to book if these guests pay a $750 refundable deposit or provide proof of damage insurance. 
**We do not accept bookings from guests within a 50-mile radius.

OPTIONAL FEES:
The following fees are paid in addition to and after the reservation is paid for.
- $249 / pet, pet fee (only valid on properties that allow pets. Pets cannot be left unattended which applies to ADA and service animals as well)
